data.long_meaning: Nicolea is derived from the Greek name Nikē, which means victory. The suffix -olea comes from the Greek word oléa, meaning 'maiden' or 'young woman'. Therefore, Nicolea can be translated as 'Victory of the people' or 'Victorious young woman'. The name Nicolea carries the meaning “Victory of the people” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Nicolea usually hope their child will grow to embody victory of the people and live with faith, good character and purpose.
